author: Universal Pictures
description:
From bridal shop disasters to riff-offs to reconciliations decades in the making, these six scenes capture female friendship at its funniest, messiest, and most heartfelt. Real bonds, real chaos, real loyalty — no two scenes look alike, but they all hit the same note.
